_why: PD-chip VBUS pin 32 (U401.32 / U501.32): it sat on a tiny VBUS pour of its own; KiCad reports 'Zone | Zone' and router.py skips such items, so the pin was open on every routed board (allow-listed in round 4 as 'finished by the router'). Planned link: via in the wide pin-32 pad, 0.4 mm B.Cu track under the pin row to a via in the main VBUS pour (F.Cu above pins 31-28 must stay free: CC1/CC2 escape there). m10: port 2 re-laid along the pin row like port 1 (0.25 mm, y 79.36 to clear the GND via at 86.55,78.86): the diagonal B.Cu track took the only via sites north of pins 28-31, and CC2 (pin 29) stayed open on every m7/m9 routed board.
